name: OnePieceFruit
short: Devil Fruit assignment + awakening companion for LevelUp.
description: Assigns Devil Fruits at level 5, tracks awakenings at levels 50 and 100, supports Beri rerolls and duels, tracks Pirate Rep, and includes a standalone character generator.
end_user_data_statement: Stores per-server user IDs, Devil Fruit and character choices, reroll history, Pirate Rep activity counts and streaks, and audit entries. Message text is not stored. Red data deletion requests remove the user records.
author: UltPanda
install_msg: Thanks for installing OnePieceFruit! Make sure vertyco's LevelUp cog is also installed and loaded. Load with: [p]load onepiecefruit
